title: Poor quality
text: Poor quality. I would not recommend these pillowcases. I have to wash everything before I can use them because of allergies. I washed these gentle cycle by themselves with nothing else in the machine, and when I pulled them out of the dryer they were very wrinkled and torn down the seam. Really poorly made. But at least Amazon back them up and refunded me the money.
